resources.string: Comics use these settings by default. Customize individual comics in the reader.
The local comic detector is unavailable. The translated image was not updated. Retry or check model support on this device.
Translation regions overlap and cannot be safely separated. Retranslate this page to update recognition.

Use the lightbulb to set text recognition/translation reasoning for this book. Auto follows the model configuration. Lower effort may be faster when supported. Provider-returned reasoning is collapsed by default; cached results produce no new reasoning.
Reasoning controls do not apply to image editing.
This model does not declare reasoning controls.
Only the latest 64 Ki reasoning characters are retained.
Comic analysis output exceeds the size limit. Reduce the input or choose another model.
Comic analysis returned an unsupported tool call. Check the model configuration.
The model returned no translation data. Try lower reasoning effort or another model.

Reuse saved source text, translations and anchors with the current local text removal engine, composition and translation font scale. Cached repaired backgrounds are reused. No online AI calls. Use translate / force retranslate for language, translation model or glossary changes.
Choose local erasure or overlay composition to recompose without AI.
No saved text anchors for this page. Translate it first. Full-page AI editing does not create text anchors.
Translate loaded images unless this book has its own choice.
Select a translation model from AI settings. On-device OCR and a separately selected AI OCR model send source text only to this model. Font size, wrapping and layout are calculated locally.

Add an image provider in AI settings and enable image editing output on its model. Native OpenAI, Gemini, Seedream, Qwen, xAI and SiliconFlow image protocols are supported. Each page segment can incur a paid request; providers are never switched automatically.

Creates a separate marked original preview during translation or Recompose. Does not alter the translated image.
Red: source · Green: layout · Yellow: bubble · Blue: glyph sample · Purple: cleanup

Local detection supplies numbered positions. The AI reads the original page and enlarged crops, translates, and chooses line breaks and direction. Numbered regions keep their original positions and use measured source lettering as the font baseline, shrinking on overflow. Without candidates, the AI locates text directly. Following the translation model uses one request; separate models run recognition, translation, then visual layout. AI location always uses this recognition and typesetting flow.
The AI did not return a complete usable typesetting plan. Retry translation or select on-device or cloud OCR.
Delete saved translations for this book. Settings and glossary are kept.
